Real browser: system administrator created the 客户管理 / 客户档案 module, configured required text and status fields, passed publication checks, published v1 and entered the runtime.

Role 业务成员 is published and assigned to the temporary member with LIST, DETAIL, CREATE and UPDATE at ALL data scope and PAGE read/write access to both fields.
